pairs.subject: watch-cache-and-resync
pairs.evidence: features/dashboard/freshness.ts:11 The dashboard reads a local, batch-rebuilt knowledge graph that has no change stream and no poll loop, so this context keeps no replica of a remote source. A search of features/dashboard for resync, desync, resourceVersion and setInterval found nothing, and the only 'watch' hit is the 'lawwatch' import path in getDashboardData.ts.

techniques.evidence: features/dashboard/freshness.ts:11 There is no stream and no cursor that could fall out of a retained window. The graph changes only in the offline kg-compute batch.

features/dashboard/freshness.ts:42 The only memo is a TTL-bounded cache of one loader's output, filled on demand. It caches no polled per-item details, so it belongs to client-fetch-cache, not to a finality-keyed poll memo.
features/dashboard/stateSlice.ts:4 stateSlice is a pure function over finished loader projections. No shared replica or stream is fanned out to consumers.
